The '''Jesa Corporation''', or '''Jesa Corp''' was a company interested in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations and scientific research which was established by [[Jesa Corporation's founder|a woman]] of extremely rigid moral principles and unusual religious beliefs that some considered "strange"; she initially hired only like-minded individuals, so many higher-ups in Jesa Corp shared the mindset of its founder. 
The Corporation established a colony on the lush [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pergitor]] and helped turn it into a lucrative and popular world, though despite their good intentions, Jesa's continued bore mining eventually led to an increase in [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity, causing the world to become uninhabitable around [[105 BBY]].<ref name="HNN 46>''{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}''</ref> Jesa Corporation went bankrupt not long after the accident.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jesa Corporation, alongside its history, was first mentioned in [[West End Games]]' [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters|Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]. Despite it not giving a precise date for the events it covers, Galaxy Guides are supplements to WEG's [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] which is set in the years after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope]] but before [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]. Dating the supplement to the time period of the core rulebook would place Pergitor's bore mining disaster in roughly 95 BBY, having happened nearly 100 years before the Guide's present-day.

On [[March 7]], [[2002]] the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website [[HoloNet News (original website)|Holonet News]] that was created as part of the marketing campaign for the [[2002]] theatrical release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] posted [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 46]]<ref name="HNN 46" /> featuring an article about the [[Church of Infinite Perception/Legends|Church]]'s counter-coup on Pergitor, dating the event to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and subsequently preponing all of Pergitor's history by about 6 years.
